notes.text: The passage directly preserves Va in the patronymic of Rabbi Chiyya, beside other similarly formed names.
This parallel gives both Hanan bar Abba and Hanan bar Va in a single line, illustrating the textual relation of the two forms without making an identification for every Rabbi Va.

Heilprin’s generalized equivalence remains a claim about the naming form. The Jerusalem witnesses illustrate Va and Abba forms. Their examples do not give an exact Babylonian counterpart for the standalone figure.
